calibration._comment: Dev laptop (Ryzen 5 5600H). Stage time = parallel x (gemm_gflops / device all-thread GFLOPS) + serial x (gemm_gflops_1t / device 1-thread GFLOPS). Split fitted from medians of 6-thread runs and 1-thread runs at 512², 1 step (bench/rope/RESULTS.md, 2026-11-13).

sd2.title: Stable Diffusion 2.x

memory_gib._source: measured 2026-11-19 on the dev laptop, CPU only, 4 GB profile: process peak commit = base + the largest stage. SDXL-Turbo at 512 with VAE tiles 64 / 48 / 32 / 24 / 16 latent px: 1.43 / 1.01 / 0.60 / 0.43 / 0.34 GiB (least squares: 0.29 + 1.14 x (tile/64)^2); SDXL-Turbo at 768 / 1024 (tile 64) 1.46 / 1.47; FLUX 512 / 768 / 1024 (tile 64) 1.37 / 1.38 / 1.39; SD-Turbo with TAESD 0.69; denoiser-bound (tile 16): SDXL 960 0.65, SDXL 1024 0.61, FLUX 576 0.69 -> denoiser_at_512 / exponent: SDXL fitted through the denoiser-bound runs (512: 0.04 above base, 960: 0.35), FLUX the `rope profile` peak x 0.75 with the profile's exponent (the profile run overstates the real activations). Data: bench/rope/memory_4gb_cpu_2026-11-19.jsonl

sdxl._attention_note: 512 -> 1024 grew the UNet step 3.49x, below 4x: the FP16 weight reads are a fixed cost per step, which the attention-share model cannot express; share 0 is the closest (512 estimate 7.4 s vs 8.47 s measured)
sdxl._timing_source: measured 2026-11-16 on the dev laptop (SDXL-Turbo FP16, same architecture as base): 6 thr / 1 thr, Amdahl split (ratio 5.10). UNet step at 1024: 29.57 / 95.46 s. Text: 0.88 / 2.15 s. VAE: 4x the 512 decode (10.99 / 41.82 s), the un-tiled equivalent at 1024 that the tiled-VAE rule (9 tiles x (512/1024)^2) expects; measured tiled 1024: 91.35 s (rule 98.9 s).
